name: helmcraft
description: Executive cockpit over the local craft databases: treasury, people, AZG compliance, delivery risk, board briefing and snapshots

tools.name: helm_status
tools.description: Retrieve real-time executive dashboard KPIs across the local craft databases (Treasury, People, Ops Risk, Actions)

tools.name: helm_refresh
tools.description: Re-read every local craft database and return the refreshed snapshot

tools.name: helm_board_briefing
tools.description: Generate a CEO/CFO board briefing, risk radar and recommendations with provenance

tools.name: helm_cashflow_forecast
tools.description: Project cash month by month from MRR, burn and open receivables

tools.name: helm_snapshot_save
tools.description: Save the current executive snapshot to the history database

tools.name: helm_snapshot_list
tools.description: List saved executive snapshots, newest first

tools.name: helm_snapshot_delete
tools.description: Delete one saved snapshot by id

tools.name: helm_export_briefing
tools.description: Write the board briefing as Markdown

tools.name: helm_export_snapshots_csv
tools.description: Write the snapshot history as CSV

tools.name: helm_set_cash
tools.description: Set the treasury cash balance used for runway calculations

tools.name: helm_sources
tools.description: Audit every local craft database read by the cockpit (path, table, rows, status)

tools.name: helm_projects
tools.description: List tracked TaskCraft projects with delivery rollups (issues, milestones, progress)
